**Goal `ext-compiler` — a program calls an extension's class as it calls a `Core` class, type-checked and with its qualifiers enforced — has just started; nothing of it has landed yet.** The floor it carries is whatever the chain carries after goal `goal-closeout`, plus goals `ext-design`'s and `ext-host`'s checks while they are carried.

The design is settled: ADR 0246 § 8, the qualifier rules it leaves unchanged, and the user's eleven calls in the goal file's § *Standing decisions*, which no session re-decides. This goal has no record slot. Goal `ext-host` built `crates/nvs-ext`: the loader with every 0246 § 4 refusal, the packer, the per-request call path, `ExtensionError`, and a manifest model that does not link wasmtime, which is what this goal's checker reads.

Three facts about the tree as the goal was written. `Core` classes are seeded into the signature table at `crates/nvs-types/src/signatures.rs:740`, before `error_lib` and `iter_lib`; nothing registers a class a configuration names. A `Core` parameter's qualifier is in `MethodSig::param_quals` (`crates/nvs-types/src/core_lib.rs:135`), read by `admits_tainted_argument` (`crates/nvs-types/src/expr/quals.rs:312`) at `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/args.rs:117`. A `.nvst` case is written into a fresh directory as `case.nvs` (`crates/nvs-test/src/run.rs:192`), and its sections are `crates/nvs-test/src/case.rs:323`'s `KNOWN`; no section brings in a binary file.

items.text: **The fixture extension** — `Shop\Ledger` as component WAT text in `tests/conformance/ext/fixtures/`, packed by `nvs-ext`'s packer into a committed `.nvsx` beside it, its exports covering every row of 0246 § 1's table, a sink, a source, each `err` case, a trap and a source section; `crates/nvs-ext/tests/fixtures.rs` fails when a committed fixture differs from what the packer builds from its text. `rule:packaging/an-nvsx-is-one-file-carrying-its-manifest`.

**A case loads a fixture** — a new `--EXTENSION--` section in `crates/nvs-test/src/case.rs:323`'s `KNOWN`; `crates/nvs-test/src/run.rs:192`'s `run_case` copies each named fixture into the case's directory and adds its pinned `[[extension]]` entry to the case's `nvs.toml`, creating it when the case wrote none. A name with no fixture is a parse error naming it. The module doc's section list gains it.

**The layer** — a new `crates/nvs-types/src/ext_lib.rs` seeded after `iter_lib::seed` at `crates/nvs-types/src/signatures.rs:742`: each manifest class a `ClassSignature` (`signatures.rs:448`), each parameter's qualifier in `param_quals` as `crates/nvs-types/src/core_lib.rs:135` puts a `Core` member's, each `const` member typed. `rule:packaging/extension-calls-are-statically-typed`; its *Not on disk* paragraph is rewritten in the same commit.

**The set reaches the compiler** — the compile entry the CLI and the runner share reads the resolved configuration's manifests (no engine) and hands them to the checker; a class the set does not load is unknown. Then the Stage 2 checks: the `nvs-types` tests in `crates/nvs-types/tests/` and the two `tests/conformance/reject/` cases.

backlog: **Stage 3: the call** — the emit at `crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/expr.rs:1139` and the symbol binding at `crates/nvs-codegen/src/lib.rs:1954`, then the conversion of every row in `crates/nvs-ext` with `tests/convert.rs`, and two `tests/conformance/ext/` cases. Two file sets.
**Stage 4: qualifiers** — `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/quals.rs:256`, `:312`, `:342` through `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/calls.rs:228`, `:568`; five `.nvst` cases and two `nvs-ext` load refusals.
**Stage 5: the source section** — `crates/nvs-hir/src/autoload.rs:259`'s `AutoloadMap` gains the extension's namespace; a file outside it refuses the load.
**Stage 6: the tools** — `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs:1473` (`check`) and `:1505` (`test`), then `crates/nvs-lsp/src/completion.rs:679` and `crates/nvs-lsp/src/server.rs:1128`. Two file sets.
When this goal's last check goes green the driver takes goal `ext-grants`.
